content.short: Founders Inc is a venture capital firm empowering founders to build Web3 projects.
content.description: Founders Inc is a community of startup founders focused on developing emerging tech, with a clear aim to help promising companies access the right resources and guidance. DApp founders can tap hardware resources and pre-seed funding to move ideas from concept to prototypes or to usable products. The program has contributed to the growth of more than 70 DApps and protocols, including Ready Player Me and Buildspace, demonstrating a track record of supporting early-stage projects and innovations within the ecosystem.
